decisions.statement: A link is pointed at the section whose page sits where that link's path reaches.
A path reaching no page is answered by the one section of that book whose name the path ends in.
A name fitting more than one section of that book leaves its link alone.
A link left alone is no refusal.
The anchor a link carries is kept on the address that link becomes.
One edit is made for each file, however many links that file carries.
A count handed in holds how many files one run points.
The files are walked in the order their paths sort.
A file spelling no such link is left unread.
The book a section is in is read by following what each section is a section of.
Nothing here writes a body of its own.

definition: every link a book's prose spells as a file path pointed at the section that path names
